name: INDO SMC Ltd
title: INDO SMC Ltd - 544681 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book ~INR237 cr at March 31 plus ~INR125 cr added since April; management targets INR450-500 cr FY27 revenue and EBITDA above 15%, but H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+ from INR250 cr and resin supply is strained.

utilisation.quote: Currently, the first month was a bit slow, but we are going to add capex.

capex.quote: we are going to do capex in SMC, FRP plus our engineering unit, electrical engineer products, in all three.

triggers.label: Inventory ~INR85 cr, ~100 days
triggers.quote: because it had become 100 days inventory of INR85 crores

triggers.label: H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+
triggers.quote: That inflow was INR250 crores plus earlier, but now we've made it INR200 crores

triggers.label: Margin ~15%, target above 15%
triggers.quote: The target is to go above 15%, but it depends a lot on the situation

triggers.label: Order book INR237 cr plus INR125 cr
triggers.quote: We have approximately 237 crores orders. And we have already pre-ordered new add-ons of the 125 cr.

triggers.label: Capex raised: SMC, FRP, electrical
triggers.quote: we are going to do capex in SMC, FRP plus our engineering unit, electrical engineer products, in all three.

red_flags.quote: we sometimes couldn't get materials like resin and petroleum products

red_flags.label: H1 inflow target cut
red_flags.quote: But now we've made it INR200 crores because -- it's okay, we'll take it a bit slow.

So we are not thinking that far ahead right now, first of all.
